notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Aleph-tav וה־ i makim wanpela samting meri (siti o graun) we tok bilong bipo i tokim; Tok Pisin i nidim ⟨em⟩

notes.subject: em i wokim ⟨את⟩⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Samting we אותה i pointim i no klia: graun (Stat 1), o siti Yerusalayim, o ol tok bilong profet — ol tanim tok i no wankain

notes.subject: עשה · יוצר · להכינה
notes.rationale: Tripela pasin bilong wokim (wokim, fominim olsem pota, stanapim) i makim nem Yahwe tripela taim — structure i lus liklik long Tok Pisin

translation: Olsem Yahwe i tok, em i wokim ⟨את⟩⟨em⟩, Yahwe i fominim ⟨em⟩ bilong stanapim ⟨em⟩ — Yahwe, nem bilong em.

tokens.marks: em (graun/siti i stap yet, i no kalarem)
